elevr

Source: R/elevr.R
elevr.Rd

This function provides access to global raster elevation data from the OpenTopography API.

Usage

elevr(dem_type, aoi, api_key, output_file)

Arguments

dem_type

Currently supports "SRTMGL3", "SRTMGL1", "SRTMGL1_E", "AW3D30", "AW3D30_E", "SRTM15Plus", "NASADEM", "COP30", "COP90", "EU_DTM", "GEDI_L3", "GEBCOIceTopo", "GEBCOSubIceTopo", "CA_MRDEM_DTM", "CA_MRDEM_DSM", "ANADEM", "GEDTM30" from the OpenTopography API global datasets.

aoi

Defines the area of interest to crop/bound the elevation data, in *sf* format.

api_key

The OpenTopography API key.

output_file

File path to save the elevation data in raster format.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
library(pacman)
p_load(sf, slope, terra)
aoi <- sf::read_sf('ex/aoi.shp')
data <- slope::elevr('GEDTM30', aoi, api_key, 'ex/dem.tif')
plot(data)
} # }
